frame: Babylon / procedural rig frame: +Z forward, +Y up, the Bell's left at -X; glTF positions read back with x -> -x

meshes.bell_body: LOD0: hide, jaw, teeth, mouth, eyes, lids, horn nubs, claws, the bell (BELL_SHAPE lathe), the clapper, the chains (material bell_hide)
meshes.bell_shed: LOD0 phase one only: the moss mantle, moss cards and fieldstones (material bell_moss; hidden in phase two)
meshes.bell_crack: LOD0 phase two only: the opened crack seam on the bell (material bell_hide)
meshes.bell_body_lod1: LOD1 of bell_body (decimated copies, the lathe regenerated, cut-out chain cards)
meshes.bell_far: the far fog silhouette: hide, bell, mantle in one mesh

skin: joints in BELL_RIG_ROWS order (glTF joint index = rig row index; the procedural skeleton's bone index = joint index - 1); <= 4 weights per vertex; `body` has no weight; the bell and the crack are 100% on `bell`, the clapper on `clapper`, jaw parts on `jaw`, lids on the brows, the fist talons on fKnuckX; the chains take the hide's weights per vertex (no rigid links) and the loose ends hand over from the flesh at the anchor to chainX1, chainX2 taking at most half the tail

materials.bell_hide: albedo, normal (OpenGL/glTF convention), ORM (R occlusion, G roughness, B metal: the bronze and the clapper are metal, the hide is not); opaque
materials.bell_moss: the same textures; alpha MASK cutoff 0.5 (the mantle's ragged edge, the moss cards)

eyes: milky BELL_PALETTE.eye, matte, never emissive (no emissive term anywhere)
